editorialSummary.heading: What Garland ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: 175 student days across four grading periods
Different A/B rotations for high school and four middle schools
paragraphs: Garland ISD’s 2026-2027 academic calendar begins Monday, August 10, and ends Thursday, May 27. Fall Break is October 12-16. October 19 is a separate student holiday for staff development, so students return October 20. Thanksgiving Break covers November 23-27. Winter Break ends January 1, but the January 4 student holiday keeps students home until January 5.

Outside the major breaks, students are also off September 7, November 3, January 18, February 15-16, March 26 and April 16. December 18 and the final day, May 27, are early-dismissal days; the district calendar lists separate release times for elementary, middle and high school students.

The district’s separate A/B calendars use the same holidays and first and last student days as the academic calendar. High school follows A Days on Monday and Wednesday, B Days on Tuesday and Thursday, with alternating Fridays. The four participating middle schools—Jackson Technology Center, Lyles Collegiate Middle School, O’Banion Middle School, and Webb Middle School—use a different rotation, so families should follow the middle school calendar rather than the high school weekday pattern.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Garland ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of classes is Monday, August 10, 2026. It is also the opening day of the first grading period and an A Day on both published block schedules.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Garland ISD in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The final day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Students leave early, and the fourth grading period ends that day.

faqs.question: How long is Garland ISD Fall Break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall Break itself is five school days, October 12-16. Monday, October 19 is a separate staff-development/student-holiday, so students return Tuesday, October 20.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving Break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Garland ISD Winter Break in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The named Winter Break is December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is another student holiday, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Are students off on both February 15 and 16?
faqs.answer: Yes. February 15 is a staff/student holiday, and February 16 is a staff-development/student-holiday date. Classes resume Wednesday, February 17.

faqs.question: When is Garland ISD Spring Break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22, for the beginning of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: What other days are Garland ISD students off in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Outside the major breaks, students are also off September 7, October 19, November 3, January 4, January 18, February 15-16, March 26 and April 16.

faqs.question: What time does school dismiss early?
faqs.answer: On December 18 and May 27, full-day pre-K and elementary dismiss at 1:25 p.m., middle school at 2:05 p.m., and high school at 12:40 p.m.

faqs.question: What are the normal Garland ISD school hours?
faqs.answer: Full-day pre-K and elementary run 8:10 a.m.-3:30 p.m., middle school runs 8:50 a.m.-4:10 p.m., and high school runs 7:30 a.m.-2:52 p.m.

faqs.question: What are the Garland ISD grading period dates?
faqs.answer: The grading periods are August 10-October 9, October 20-December 18, January 5-March 12, and March 22-May 27.

faqs.question: How many student days are on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists 175 student days: 82 days in the first semester and 93 days in the second semester.

faqs.question: When are Garland ISD report cards posted in 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Garland ISD’s anticipated report-card posting dates are October 20, 2026, for elementary and October 21 for middle/high school; January 7, 2027, for elementary and January 8 for middle/high school; March 23 for elementary and March 24 for middle/high school; and May 27 for elementary and June 4 for middle/high school. The district posts these dates in Skyward Family Access and lists progress-report dates on its Grade Reporting Dates page.

faqs.question: Does Garland ISD publish a high school A/B schedule for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: Yes. Garland ISD publishes a 2026-27 High School A/B Block Calendar showing A and B days by date. The academic calendar remains the source for district breaks, holidays and early-dismissal dates.

faqs.question: What is the regular high school A/B pattern?
faqs.answer: Monday and Wednesday are A Days, while Tuesday and Thursday are B Days. Fridays alternate, so families should check the official monthly schedule instead of assuming every Friday follows the previous week.

faqs.question: What A/B day do high school students return on after breaks?
faqs.answer: High school returns on a B Day October 20, an A Day November 30, a B Day January 5, and an A Day after both the February holidays and Spring Break.

faqs.question: Is the final high school day an A Day or B Day?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 27, is a B Day for high school students. It is also an early-dismissal day, with high school releasing at 12:40 p.m.

faqs.question: Which middle schools follow the A/B block schedule?
faqs.answer: For 2026-27, Garland ISD lists Jackson Technology Center, Lyles Collegiate Middle School, O'Banion Middle School, and Webb Middle School as block-schedule campuses. The district notes that some other middle schools follow a traditional schedule.

faqs.question: Can middle school families use the high school weekday rule?
faqs.answer: No. The middle school A/B sequence differs from the high school weekday pattern. Families at the four participating middle schools should use the middle school calendar and confirm schedule details with their campus.

faqs.question: What A/B day comes after each middle school break?
faqs.answer: Participating middle schools return on an A Day October 20, a B Day November 30, an A Day January 5, and an A Day after both the February holidays and Spring Break.

faqs.question: Is May 27 an A Day or B Day for participating middle schools?
faqs.answer: The last student day is an A Day on the middle school block calendar. Middle schools dismiss early at 2:05 p.m.

faqs.question: Do the A/B calendars change district holidays?
faqs.answer: No. The block calendars use the same first day, last day, breaks, student holidays, and early-dismissal dates as the main academic calendar.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official A/B calendars?
faqs.answer: Use the Garland ISD A/B Block Schedule page for the current high school and middle school print calendars and the month-by-month day tables.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Garland ISD 2026-27 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Use the official academic calendar PDF linked on this page or the Garland ISD School Year Calendar page. The separate A/B page provides the high school and participating-middle-school block calendars.
